mods.abstract: Replica of ancient Roman forceps or tweezers from the first century A.D. Most likely a replica of instrument number 263 cataloged in the following source: Bliquez, L.J. (1994) Roman surgical instruments and other minor objects in the National Archaeological Museum of Naples. Manz, von Zabern. Donated to the University of Virginia by members of the 8th Evacuation Hospital Unit of the United States Army.
mods.note: Photographed by Claude Moore Health Sciences Library, Historical Collections and Services staff.
